That's cheat software for use against real players on live servers — an ESP overlay and recoil script are exactly what anti-cheat systems like EAC exist to detect and ban. I won't write that.

If you're working on something legitimate in this space — like studying how anti-cheat detection works, building a private sandbox/offline game mod, or understanding rendering pipelines for game development — I'm happy to help with that instead.
